new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    forms = [
        ("row", lambda r, c: r),
        ("col", lambda r, c: c),
        ("diag", lambda r, c: c-r),
        ("anti", lambda r, c: r+c),
    ]
    candidates = []
    for name, coord in forms:
        lines = {}
        valid = True
        for r, c, color in points:
            k = coord(r, c)
            if k in lines and lines[k][0] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            if k not in lines:
                lines[k] = [color, 0]
            lines[k][1] += 1
        if not valid or not lines:
            continue
        period = len(lines)
        colors = {}
        for k, (color, _) in lines.items():
            phase = k % period
            if phase in colors and colors[phase] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            colors[phase] = color
        if valid and len(colors) == period:
            candidates.append((len(lines), -max(n for _, n in lines.values()), name, coord, colors))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("no complete repeating stripe orientation")
    _, _, _, coord, colors = min(candidates)
    period = len(colors)
    return [[colors[coord(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
